bio: 28+ years of veteran engineering excellence. structuredCv.summary: Dedicated Structural Engineer with 28+ years of experience across Bangladesh, UAE, Malaysia, and Oman. Specialist in high-rise residential & commercial buildings (up to 40 stories), prestressed concrete box girders, viaducts, transit stations, and heavy industrial structures.

education.institution: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET), Dhaka

experience.company: Sodev Consult Int. Ltd. (RCIPF under Oriental Consultants Global, Japan / ADB)
experience.highlights: Detailed analysis, design & reports for 90+ Railway stations; structural design of railway workshops in Saidpur, Parbatipur, Pahartoli, and Tejgaon depots.

Dhaka Mass Rapid Transit (MRT Line 1) elevated stations (Joar Sahara, Boalia, Mostul, Purbachal West, Purbachal Centre, Terminal); MRT Line 5 North Viaduct from Hemayetpur to Vatara in MIDAS-Civil; Inner Circular Ring Road Rayer Bazar to Postogola (Terminal building, underpasses, toll plaza for 6-lane expressway).
Concept & detail design for 53.64-acre residential development with building towers ranging from 25 to 40 stories (12,000,000 sq ft built-up area).

Analysis and design of (4B+G+19) 23-storied S. Alam International Hospital in Chittagong; 20-storied residential buildings for Bangladesh Bank, Motijheel; 8-storied diagnostic imaging systems across 7 divisional medical colleges funded by JICA.

experience.company: SMHB Sdn Bhd, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

3,00,000 sqm textile factory for Crystal Group; Western Marine office building; 13-storied Air Force officers mess in Cox's Bazar; World Bank-funded 3-storied cyclone shelters under ECRRP.
